entities.name: Viridian elves
entities.description: Long-eared elves in copper armor who live in the Tangle.

entities.name: the Tangle
entities.description: A green region of Mirrodin of verdigris-covered trees, part of which merges with the Mephidross.

entities.name: nim
entities.description: Gray-skinned undead made by the necrogen gases of the Mephidross.

entities.name: the Mephidross
entities.description: A region of Mirrodin where necrogen gases turn living tissue into nim; home of the Moriok.

entities.name: Moriok
entities.description: Human dwellers of the Mephidross with dark metal fused into their bodies.

entities.name: Rey-Goor
entities.description: The part of the Tangle that merges with the Mephidross.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whose story continues in the Scars of Mirrodin block.

events.summary: As depicted in the art of Blunt the Assault, nim attack Viridian elves in the Tangle without harming the unconcerned elves above.
events.quote: They must be nim, the necrogen-plagued undead of the Mephidross.

relations.quote: The Moriok dwell in the Mephidross, where necrogen gases slowly turn living tissue into the nim.
the Rey-Goor, which is the name of a part of the Tangle that merges with the Mephidross
